title: Descended finite etale complexes and algebraic stalk reduction isomorphisms
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian quasi-compact scheme, let $d$ be an adic coefficient datum on $A$, and let $M$ be a derived module over its completed coefficient sheaf, with coefficient isomorphisms $\varphi_n$ compatible with the quotient maps and completed scalar map [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum, def-weil-pbc-complete-coefficient-datum, def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-koszul-completion, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Assume the finite quotient constant functors preserve zero maps and $M$ has uniform finite-perfect quotient models [lem-weil-pbc-residue-perfect-finite-quotient-models, pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. There is an etale cover $\{V_i\to X\}$ and on each chart algebraic levels $F_{i,n}$, each perfect, and consecutive scalar-extension isomorphisms [def-sfb-module-derived-scalar-comparisons] $F_{i,n+1}\otimes^L A/I^{n+1}\simeq F_{i,n}$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-tower-data, def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. Each $V_i$ is connected and has a chosen ordinary point $v_i$ [def-weil-connected-scheme]. For every $n$ there is a bounded etale complex $L_{i,n}$ with finite locally constant cohomology over $\operatorname{ULift}(A/I^{n+1})$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-constructible-locally-constant]. Write $E_{i,n}$ for its exact derived stalk at the geometric point given by an algebraic closure of $\kappa(v_i)$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. For every etale $U\to V_i$, a supplied isomorphism $L_{i,n}|_U\simeq\underline{E_{i,n}}_U$ transports, along every $X$-etale arrow $W\to U$, to an isomorphism between the actual finite quotient $M_n|_W$ and finite coefficient constant realization of $F_{i,n}|_W$ [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-derived-restriction, def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. The data do not supply such an etale stalk isomorphism or a covering on which one exists, nor compatible markings or a common pro-etale cover. The adjoint transitions, their normalization proofs and all marking sieves are constructed in the parent, not supplied here.

proof.text: Pull the uniform model sieve back from the categorical terminal object to the identity X-etale chart. For each x choose a model chart over x and a connected open neighborhood of its lifted point inside an affine neighborhood. Locally Noetherian connected components are open. Pulling back the model sieve preserves all uniform bounds. These point-indexed charts give an etale cover; empty X gives the empty cover.

Apply single finite-level etale descent separately at every n on each connected chart and choose its data inside this proof. Define E_n to be the small algebraic fibre; its perfectness is a field of these data.

Apply consecutive stalk reduction to the two supplied level records. Its proof uses finite-ring local constancy to obtain a nonempty common constant-model chart, then scalar balancing of those two actual quotient models. This constructs the asserted pairwise scalar-extension isomorphisms without descending quotient arrows or choosing simultaneous markings.

Package the recorded connectedness, point, etale levels, bounds and lisse cohomology. Compose any supplied isomorphism to the actual stalk with the constant image of the recorded stalk-to-algebra isomorphism. The single-level transport field then gives exactly the original transport conclusion for every further W.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09C6: single finite-level descent, connected local constancy, and local scalar balancing; Noetherian connected open refinements. Pairwise isomorphisms suffice; adjoint transition assembly remains in the parent.
